versions.changelog:
Initial release: AI-powered crypto futures scalping signals for agents.

- Includes 10+ analyzed trading strategies, from liquidity sweep reversals to order flow divergence.
- Real-time setup scanning, pair analysis, and session-based trade filters (London/NY kill zones).
- Built-in risk management: position sizing, daily loss limits, leverage caps, max concurrent trades.
- Supports multiple exchanges (MEXC, Binance) and key futures pairs.
- Signals generated only during high-probability market conditions; strict commission and slippage controls.
